def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
 # identify components by color, orthogonal
 seen=set(); objs=[]
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   col=grid[r][c]
   if col in (0,8) or (r,c) in seen: continue
   st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
   while st:
    y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     p=(y+dy,x+dx)
     if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==col:
      seen.add(p); st.append(p)
   objs.append((col,comp))
 # movement to right sequentially; obstacles are all stationary positions initially, but allow each object slide
 for col,comp in objs:
  for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=0
  shift=0
  while True:
   ns=[(y,x+shift+1) for y,x in comp]
   if any(x>=w or out[y][x]!=0 for y,x in ns): break
   shift+=1
  # issue out cells currently contain unprocessed object blockers; okay
  for y,x in comp: out[y][x+shift]=col
 return out
PY
